acip: DE NAS NUB GCIG RTOGS LDAN PA'I MNAL LAM DU, RJE RIN PO CHE PA'I MCHOD RTEN YIN ZER BA'I PHYAG TSAD YONGS SU RDZOGS PA, NOR BU RIN PO CHE'I TOG SPRIN GYI GSEB NA SLEB PA, KHA DOG SHIN TU DKAR ZHING MKHREGS PA DKAR YOL GYI RNAM PA LTA BU BYAS PA ZHIG LA, MKHA' 'GRO MA MANG PO 'DUS PA,
english: There came then to Tokdenpa a dream.  There was a certain offering shrine, which people were saying was Je Tsongkapa's.  It was perfectly constructed, in the traditional layout, and at the tip it had a jeweled point which pierced the clouds.  In color it was a perfect, pure white, and it was was solid, as if it were made of porcelain.  Many Angels of the Sky were gathered around it.
wylie: de nas nub gcig rtogs ldan pa'i mnal lam du, rje rin po che pa'i mchod rten yin zer ba'i phyag tshad yongs su rdzogs pa, nor bu rin po che'i tog sprin gyi gseb na sleb pa, kha dog shin tu dkar zhing mkhregs pa dkar yol gyi rnam pa lta bu byas pa zhig la, mkha' 'gro ma mang po 'dus pa
